verdicts.reason: Both break the design the same way. The geometric pattern is cut down to a narrow strip, and an empty white frame holding the two pink dots floats off on the right as dead space. 'DDG STUDIO PRESENTS' sits off to the left and doesn't line up with anything. The 'THE MINIMALIST' pill runs straight into the 'OPENING…' line, so the reading order is jumbled and the poster's structure is gone. B is slightly worse: 'DEAN COOPER' is pushed out to the card's edge and the white block covers more of the pattern, while A leaves a little more of the brand pattern visible.
